items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: We had Johnny Hill, Claiborne Roy, Esau Lewis, David Lewis, Oscar Shields, Joseph Pugh, Sullivan Pugh, Joseph Phillip, and what they named, Dukes, Arthur Dukes, and myself, Daniel Hadley, that's 11, and Kemp Hadley, Holly Taylor.

ctx.x: But I put it up though. It was going from 18 to 35. And I put it up. If you look it up, you find out I was born in 1894. But I was born, and I have to tell you the truth, but I was born in 1895 see. But after I put it up to 1894 I let it stay there see. But I was 17, I ain't no joke about that. And so out there how big would those bands be, the different ones? The band we had must have had about, I'll tell you. We had Johnny Hill, Claiborne Roy, Esau Lewis, David Lewis, Oscar Shields, Joseph Pugh, Sullivan Pugh,…
And what instruments would those guys play?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: You ever heard of David Lewis? He was a good watchboard player.

ctx.x: But, his first name was something else. Oh, I see. We can look that up. Uh, now, who was some of the watchboard players? Did the, did the drummers do that ever?
Well, no. There was a special fella on there. Did you know- You ever heard of David Lewis? He was a good watchboard player.
I heard of him, but I don't think he was a bass player. I get confused. He was a good watchboard player.
